description: Distil trajectory corpus — real, captured-style agent runs across domains. Each is a 4-turn headless agent loop with a cacheable stable prefix, decision-driven volatile tool outputs, and causally-inert noise. The corpus is the asset that makes certification meaningful beyond a single example.

live_only.title: CI dashboard tile — repeated screenshots
live_only.why_not_in_the_offline_gate: The decision is carried by the IMAGE, not by text. The offline gate's DeterministicRunner grades by reading DECISION: markers out of block text, and corpus.validate() requires one on a decision-relevant volatile block. Satisfying that here would mean writing the tile's colour into the text — at which point the image is decorative and any resulting certificate is a claim about text, not vision. This domain is therefore certified ONLY against a live vision runner: distil certify --strategy vision --runner anthropic --trajectory corpus/vision-ci-dashboard.json
